summary: Proposes compressing history_node->data cells which can reach 2MB in production, with configurable minimum size thresholds to avoid compression overhead for small payloads.
userImpact: Users with large workflow histories pay more for storage and experience potential performance degradation from large uncompressed data cells.
rootCause: Data cells are stored uncompressed by default despite being written once and rarely read, leading to 2MB+ sizes in production workloads.
proposedFix: Use PayloadCodec interface to implement compression for history_node->data cells with configurable minimum size thresholds.
keyQuote: Some data cells can be 2M or so large, which isn't great, considering this is just proto3 data, written once, rarely read.
